discrepancies.title: Shader Container Database Inventory Discrepancy
discrepancies.impact: Low (52 containers in DB vs 81 physical in files)
discrepancies.description: The components table contains 52 shader container records. The 29 containers embedded in amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_xbox.dll were disassembled for instructions but not inserted as container components in DB.

discrepancies.title: Container Packaging & Terminology Classification
discrepancies.description: Containers in amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_xbox.dll are standard DXBC v1 containers with proprietary AMD ACCC chunks and inner XPSF precompiled shader format, generated by Scarlett GDK compiler, not open-source ACO.

discrepancies.title: Opcode Uniqueness vs Semantic Variant Merging
discrepancies.description: 202 reported instructions represent distinct mnemonic/variant strings. Distinct (family, opcode) pairs number 194 due to DPP8/DPP16 variants, yielding 186 distinct semantic algebraic operations.

discrepancies.title: Dependency Edge Resolution Semantics
discrepancies.description: Of 1,367 import edges in the graph, 258 resolve against existing workspace DLL exports, while 1,079 represent unresolved imports of external platform libraries (d3d12_xs.dll, xmem.dll, XAudio2_9.dll).

discrepancies.title: Automated Testing Scope vs Behavioral Compatibility
discrepancies.description: Passing test suite covers scanner parser utility functions and data model validation. Unit test execution does not execute x86-64 machine instructions or prove binary execution compatibility.
